scientific_limitations_integrity.integrity: The infinite proof uses the published Lucas-sequence valuation formula and a symbolic kernel-span/independence argument. The included finite script is a consistency check only. Independent audit and independent validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations_integrity.limits: No claim for odd a, even b, degenerate recurrences, or bases other than 4.
scientific_limitations_integrity.scope: Nondegenerate Lucas sequences U_0=0, U_1=1, U_{n+2}=aU_{n+1}+bU_n with nonzero even a and odd b; base k=4 only.

title: Exact 4-kernel rank for a family of Lucas-sequence valuations
